caption: The drawing depicts a sculptural composition consisting of a green, roughly rectangular base with vertical edges. On top of this base, there are several green leaves and red, rounded objects that resemble fruits or flowers. Seated among the foliage are two carved brown figures: one is a bird with outstretched wings, elevated and perched at the back, while the other is an animal with an open mouth and a red object in its mouth, positioned in front of the bird. The scene is rendered with detailed crosshatching and shading, and the primary colors used are brown for the carvings, green for the foliage and base, and red for the rounded elements. The background is plain with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Squirrel and Eagle
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
